recommended.why: the only MTP block that pays with the flat-verify tile off: 1.53-1.66x over plain decode on prose, block 4 reads 0.86-0.99x and block 8 0.56-0.65x

the 8-row tile costs plain decode 17-23% and sequential prefill 27-31%; it pays only with a block of 4 or more (DFlash2 7: +10% on medium-review, 1.8x on copy-heavy), so it stays opt-in until the per-request block choice is decided
the tuned 3,1,1,2 controller under the tile loses 5.6% to the default on prose and wins only on code (+6.4%) and quote-back (+17.1%); flag off, fixed 2 beats every controller setting

default on: the Dk-baked delta kernels won +4.1% and +5.0% (confirm) on DFlash2 7 and +5.3% on prefill, bit-exact; plain decode is NOISE (re-confirmed 2026-10-28, and the same run's prefill side-read the -5.3% again)
default on: 1.024-1.027x on speculative decode, and rollback plus commit cost 0.15 ms of an 85 ms round afterwards
the GQA-shared kernel is already this family's default for the trunk and, since 2026-10-23, the DFlash2 drafter; forcing barrier as a baseline also forces the trunk
default on: the chunked driver with aux capture reads 130-158 prefill tok/s against 16-23 for the token walk; the paired verdict is still owed (walk arms were dirty)
lossless and +5-10% committed per round live, but the tree verify costs 5-7% more than the chain, so the net is even to +4% from dirty runs; not a default
follow-up TTFT falls 98.5% on the long-doc chat, but the +147 MiB peak fails the 64 MiB memory gate, so it stays off until the snapshot is cheaper
